title: The Ridiculous Fake Vat of Acid — Part 1

series.series_summary: After a fake acid vat escape goes humiliatingly wrong, Rick and Morty engage in a bitter war of egos over a video game reset remote, triggering devastating multiverse chaos until Morty is forced to crawl back to the vat.

series_summary: After a fake acid vat escape goes humiliatingly wrong, Rick and Morty engage in a bitter war of egos over a video game reset remote, triggering devastating multiverse chaos until Morty is forced to crawl back to the vat.

segments.voiceover_text: Rick claims he invented the ultimate escape: a fake vat of acid with hidden air hoses and release bones. Morty is visibly appalled by how humiliating the idea sounds.
When alien mobsters draw guns, Rick dives straight into the acid, forcing Morty to plunge in beside him as fake skeletons float up to fool the gangsters.

After hours trapped underwater, Rick violently slaughters the gangsters. Morty erupts in disgust at the humiliating ordeal. Can Rick admit his idea was garbage, or will his bruised ego spark a dangerous retaliation?
